# `passportsim net_capture`

Read the Wi-Fi data plane's pcap capture, or write it as an artifact.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `radio` |
| MCP tool | `passport_net_capture` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/net_capture` |
| Scenario step | `net.capture` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim net_capture [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--label <LABEL>] [--op <OP>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `label` | `--label <LABEL>` | `string` | no | - |
| `op` | `--op <OP>` | `"status"` \| `"save"` | no | Default status. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/net_capture.input.json`](../schema/commands/net_capture.input.json).

## Output

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/net_capture.output.json`](../schema/commands/net_capture.output.json).

## Examples

### Count the captured frames

```sh
passportsim net_capture --json - <<'JSON'
{}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{}
'@ | passportsim net_capture --json -
```

### Write the capture as net/dhcp.pcap

```sh
passportsim net_capture --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "label": "dhcp",
  "op": "save"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "label": "dhcp",
  "op": "save"
}
'@ | passportsim net_capture --json -
```
